summary: The evidence verifier passes over a passing shard's own note (the policy's shard_inputs.index, kit_shard for fractal-web) when it picks the latest record, so the merge queue's per-shard fractal-web notes no longer shadow the whole run's note under the same input key. A failing shard's note still decides.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.

schema.detail: .st/evidence-skip-policy.json: shard_inputs takes an optional index input name; fractal-web's is kit_shard.

rules.detail: A passing record that carries its kind's shard index input never decides; a failing one decides as check_failed; passing shard records alone read no_record (no_note).

compatibility.detail: The gate reads the policy and the verifier from the same accepted base.

recovery.detail: Revert: the newest shard note decides again and is refused as missing_input.
